messages:
ana: heads up — I’m seeing ~2% of token accounting events vanish between 02:00-03:30 UTC in billing_event_sink. skimmed a few customer traces and token totals are lower than expected :thinking_face:

devon: when did this start? can you paste the query you ran?

ana: ran this quick aggregate against staging/canonical events:```sql
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) as hr, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE received_at >= '2025-08-12'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr;
```
I compared with the invoice-agg output and the hr buckets from 02:00-03:00 are short by ~2%.

raj: saw similar blips last night in consumer-group logs — we had two partition rebalances in that timeframe. suspect some partially-processed aggregates got dropped during the rejoin.

ops-bot: [ALERT] billing_event_sink: consumer_group rebalances >1 within 30m (group=billing-sink, topic=usage-events) — https://grafana/redwood/d/sinks

sre-oncall: rebalances were caused by a rolling restart on dedicated nodes (deploy #4257). we left in-place max.poll.interval.ms=5m so long polls could time out.

kevin: quick note: our dedupe strategy currently uses dedupe_key = request_id only. when a single request spans multiple chunks we sometimes emit multiple partial events that the aggregator expects to join; if a chunk's ack is missed during rebalance it becomes orphaned. recommend switching dedupe_key to:```text
{customer_id}:{request_id}:{chunk_index}
```
and increase the aggregator pending window from 24h -> 72h for safety.

devon: +1 on 72h for pending-aggregates. also we should persist consumer offsets only after commit to s3 staging so we don’t lose in-flight batches on rebalance. small change in sink consumer loop: move offset commit to after flush to s3.

ana: I can cut a hotfix PR for the dedupe key + offset commit change. will also bump the TTL. opening now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7382 (diff + unit tests) commit 9f1c3ad

billing-engineer: how does this affect invoices? rough calc: at scale a 2% undercount for token events in that window maps to ~0.15% revenue impact across August invoices — small but customers with bursty usage could see visible slide. we should run a reconciliation pass for that date range.

raj: rollback is noisy given the deploys; prefer forward fix + reconciliation job that backfills missing chunk joins and re-emits corrected events. can we run reconciliation before next billing cutoff?

ana: yes — I’ll add a sql backfill + an idempotent emitter. Plan: 1) land hotfix + deploy canary, 2) run backfill for 2025-08-12 02:00-04:00, 3) run diff check and publish corrected billing events to invoice-agg as idempotent replays.

kevin: also add a metric for "aggregator.pending_orphans" and alert at >1000 over 1h so we catch this earlier.

devon: added a TODO in the PR to include docs for the dedupe_key format and the reason for 72h window.

ops-bot: deploy started: platform/hotfix-dedupe (canary) — build #5623 — https://ci/redwood/builds/5623

ana: thanks — tagging @sre-oncall for monitor tweaks and @billing-engineer for backfill run once hotfix is green. :+1:

billing-engineer: will coordinate reconciliation. if we need to issue any adjustments we’ll prepare proforma notes.

sre-oncall: monitoring updated: consumer offset commit metric + orphan gauge. will watch the canary. good catch everyone :rocket:
